### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you’re looking for a high\-profile, challenging opportunity supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has an exciting opportunity for you. This position will join a dynamic team supporting Team Submarine. Bring your expertise, technical skills, and collaborative approach to a mission\-critical role that helps advance U.S. national security and the safety and effectiveness of our Sailors.


**Ability to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**


About the Program


Program Executive Office Submarines, Program Manager for the Virginia\-Class Submarine (PMS 450\), is responsible for the acquisition of the U.S. Navy’s Virginia\-Class nuclear\-powered attack submarines. PMS 450 identifies, assembles, manages, directs, and coordinates the resources required for research and development, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T\&E), Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT\&E), and fleet introduction.


PMS 450 is responsible for developing and deploying an affordable, nuclear\-powered attack submarine with multi\-mission capabilities and enhanced performance in littoral environments. Virginia\-Class submarines support five of the Navy’s six core maritime capabilities: Deterrence, Maritime Security, Sea Control, Forward Presence, and Power Projection.

  



The Opportunity


Serco is seeking an Onboarding and Systems Specialist to manage the end\-to\-end integration of personnel and streamline administrative workflows for the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine organization, specifically supporting the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, DC.


In this role, you will oversee onboarding and offboarding processes for civilian, military, and contractor personnel while serving as a primary administrator for Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform automated workflows. You will help modernize administrative processes, improve workforce visibility, and develop digital solutions that increase efficiency across the program.


This is an excellent opportunity to join our team and contribute to the delivery of cutting\-edge undersea warfare capabilities for the U.S. Navy.

  



What You’ll Do


* Manage the end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding lifecycle for civilian, military, and contractor personnel assigned to the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program, ensuring a seamless transition into and out of the organization.
* Maintain, configure, and continuously improve the program’s onboarding systems, databases, and portal pages hosted on Microsoft SharePoint.
* Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain custom Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate workflows to streamline manual routing, data entry, approvals, notifications, and other administrative processes.
* Collaborate with adjacent Team Submarine program offices to support their onboarding operations, share best practices, and expand successful automation solutions across the organization.
* Coordinate with security managers, IT support teams, facilities personnel, and sponsor representatives to ensure timely provisioning of physical workspaces, Common Access Cards (CACs)/badges, network accounts, computer equipment, and other required resources.
* Maintain accurate personnel rosters, onboarding records, and historical staffing data.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reports to support workforce planning, program reviews, and leadership decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes through automation, standardization, and digital transformation.

Provide user support and troubleshooting for SharePoint\-based onboarding tools and automated workflows.  
* 

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business management, computer science, or a related field and minimum 8 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, workflow automation, SharePoint administration, Microsoft Power Platform solutions, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* **Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Demonstrated experience building and managing Microsoft SharePoint sites, including custom lists, libraries, pages, and site structures.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Hands\-on experience developing applications using Microsoft Power Apps.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to travel approximately 10% of the time.

Desired Qualifications


* Experience supporting personnel onboarding, workforce operations, or administrative processes within a DoD/Navy acquisition program office, Program Executive Office (PEO), or Navy command environment.
* Experience gathering and translating requirements from non\-technical stakeholders into intuitive, user\-friendly digital forms, applications, and workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to identify administrative bottlenecks, analyze complex operational processes, and develop and implement digital solutions that improve efficiency.
* Experience developing SharePoint\-based dashboards, reporting tools, or workforce tracking solutions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
* Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across military, civilian, contractor, and government organizations.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a diverse, mission\-focused team.
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  

  

To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/what\-we\-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco\-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800\-628\-6458, option 1\. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  

  

Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government\-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. For more information on how Serco uses your information, please see our Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice.
  

  

Serco does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies without being a contracted approved vendor. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Serco and will not be obligated to pay a placement or contract fee. If you are interested in becoming an approved vendor at Serco, please email Agencies@serco\-na.com.
  

  

Serco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

  

  

### **Pay Transparency**

  

  

Our Total Rewards package includes competitive pay, performance\-based incentives, and benefits that promote well\-being and work\-life balance—so you can thrive both professionally and personally. Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time\-off programs that support work\-life balance. Program availability may vary based on factors such as contract type, location, hire date, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.
  

  

Salary range: The range for this position can be found at the top of this posting. This range is provided as a general guideline and represents a good faith estimate across all experience levels. Actual base salary will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the scope of the role, relevant experience, job\-related knowledge, education and training, key skills, and geographic market considerations. For roles available in multiple states, the range may vary to reflect differences in local labor markets. In addition to base salary, eligible positions may include other forms of compensation such as annual bonuses or long\-term incentive opportunities. Benefits – Comprehensible benefits for full\-time employees (part\-time employees receive a limited package tailored to their role):  

  

  



* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Robust vacation and sick leave benefits, and flexible work arrangements where permitted by role or contract
* 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages that can be purchased, including pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Employee Assistance Plan
  

  

  

To review all Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/about\-us.
  

  

Serco complies with all applicable state and local leave laws, including providing time off under the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for eligible Colorado residents, in alignment with our policies and benefit plans. The application window for this position is for no more than 60 days. We encourage candidates to apply promptly after the posting date, as the position may close earlier if filled or if the application volume exceeds expectations. Please submit applications exclusively through Serco’s external (or internal) career site. If an applicant has any concerns with job posting compliance, please send an email to: careers@serco\-na.com.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist (Bilingual English/Spanish)
jobs.description:
The Onboarding Specialist will communicate, grow, build, and raise awareness of RouteOne services and our Integrated Partner Programs among RouteOne’s dealer customer base. This new role, within RouteOne’s Sales organization, will play a critical role in driving dealer and Integrated Partner engagement and utilization of RouteOne’s platform by supporting our Integrated Partners’ Go\-to\-Market requirements, new dealer onboarding, activation of services and system training.


This position will serve as a Full\-Time role supporting multiple Integrated Partners and a national dealership market.

**Job Requirements**

* Lead the Dealer Onboarding Experience:
	+ Collaborate with internal support personnel, sales teams, and RouteOne Integrated Partners to coordinate and execute all aspects of new dealer onboarding, ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
	+ Contact automotive dealerships nationwide to configure RouteOne functionality based on Integrated Partner’s program requirements
	+ Become an expert on dealership processes and indirect finance through internal training programs.
	+ Identify and report on dealer conversion opportunities.
	+ Maintain records of dealership contacts and activities.
* Support the Partner Onboarding Experience:
	+ Support the execution of RouteOne Integrated Partners’ account strategies, meeting all timeline metrics for each account with a customer\-centric approach.
	+ Work closely with Sales, Customer Solutions, and Integrated Partners to gather and maintain a thorough understanding and documentation of each Integrated Partner’s requirements to ensure dealer onboarding requirements are met and dealer participation agreements are completed in accordance with Go\-Live dates.
	+ Develop launch reports, track and monitor activities, and escalate blockers or delays to dealer sales teams and Integrated Partners.
	+ Support administrative and operational tasks related to field activities, such as integration or onboarding related troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain exceptional customer satisfaction.
	+ “Be the voice of the customer”
		- Identify and report obstacles preventing dealer or Integrated Partner satisfaction or utilization
		- Recommend actions to minimize or eliminate dissatisfiers; and
		- Respond to Dealer and Integrated Partner needs and follow through on commitments/deliverables.
* Maintain safety, security, and privacy standards throughout all areas of responsibility.

**Knowledge**

* Basic knowledge of dealership systems and new digital retail technologies, credit processes, and B2C eCommerce solutions.
* General understanding of auto dealer and finance source processes and relationships.

**Skills**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office products, including but not limited to: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Visio.

**Abilities**

* Build relationships both within and across organizations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Motivation to work in a customer\-first culture, independently and in a team environment.
* Develop and maintain a working understanding of RouteOne products/services.

**Other Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 0\-2 years of experience preferred.
* Salesforce and Jira experience preferred but not required.  

  

The annual base salary range for this position is $67,000 \- $90,000\. This range represents RouteOne's good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.  

  

Actual compensation will be determined based on scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, and skill set, as well as market and business considerations. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for performance\-based bonuses. Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, tuition reimbursement parental leave, paid time off, and paid holidays. A more detailed description of RouteOne's benefits offerings is available at https://routeone.com/employee\-benefits.

jobs.title: HCAI - HEALTH INFORMATION AND ELECTRONIC RECORDS ANALYST TRAINING PROGRAM
jobs.description:
Description: **\*\*\*Eligible Applicants must be residents of California. \*\*\*****Next Cohorts Begin: 11/17/2026**  

**\*\*PLEASE NOTE: "This is a grant\-funded training program, not an employment opportunity" Employment is not guaranteed at the completion of the program\*\***  

**Selection for participation in the training program is NOT guaranteed.** **Applying** **or** **being referred** **to apply does NOT guarantee acceptance, as participation is subject to HCAI enrollment guidelines.****Description:**


The Health Information and EHR Systems Analyst program (HIER) is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to manage healthcare information and electronic health record (EHR) systems effectively. This program provides hands\-on training in EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports, preparing students for real\-world challenges in clinical data management, system implementation, and reporting. Participants will also gain foundational knowledge to support healthcare IT systems, ensuring data accuracy, security, and compliance.

***This program prepares students for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification, providing a strong pathway into health information technology and EHR specialist roles across healthcare settings.***

**Note: This program consists of 3 Phases:**

**1\. Online classroom training (approximately 18 weeks)**

**2\. Online Internship (approximately 11 weeks)**

**3\. Externship\- in person/onsite for hand\-on training (approximately 10 weeks)**

**Participation in all components above is required and require a commitment of 40 hours per week during standard business hours. The entire program as a whole is approximately 39\-44 weeks in duration.**

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* **Applicants must be residents of California and live within 30–45 minutes of San** **Jose, CA.**
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must have a high school diploma or GED certification
* Must be a U.S. Citizen/National or have a valid Lawful Permanent Resident Alien (not open to non\-citizens or Visa holders)
* Must have proficient computer experience (MS Windows \& MS Suite (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook)
* Ability to type Net 40 wpm
* **Great attention to detail and strict HIPAA compliance**
* **Analytical and detail oriented.**
* **Able to learn in a self\-directed, fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment.**

**Program Details:**

* ***Schedule:*** The training program runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and includes a living stipend.
* ***Commitment:*** The program includes remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/externship training. Accepted participants must complete 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during regular business hours for the entire duration of the program.
* ***Compensation*****:** $31,200, This stipend is distributed over approximately 44 weeks for participation in both remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/ externship training. Stipend payment is made on OCHIN’s semi\-monthly pay schedule.
* ***Benefits:*** Eligible for monthly benefits reimbursement of up to $600 (participant cost only). Some restrictions apply. Also, Internet Stipend $35/month for 44 weeks
* ***Attendance Policy:***Participants are not eligible to receive paid holidays or paid time off (PTO), all missed time will need to be made up.

**Program Objectives:**

* Learn to apply specialized health care and database management insights to analyze important clinical data, identify trends, and create targeted reports.
* Develop expertise in managing health information and EHR systems to support healthcare organizations.
* Apply data management skills using tools such as EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports to analyze and report clinical data.
* Understand and implement system design, testing, and security protocols to ensure data privacy and compliance.
* Prepare for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification exam, focusing on healthcare IT, leadership, and system analysis.
* Support healthcare teams in optimizing operational workflows and improving patient outcomes through technology


Requirements:
* Work newly identified duplicate/overlay cases using designated reports, work queues, e\-mail communications and phone calls.
* Conduct detailed review of identified issues and documentation in logs and data bases.
* Follows established procedure for combining cases, moving cases, adding known non\-duplicates.
* Professional communication with downstream and external users.
* Review and process information collected from various inbound interfaces and Epic sub systems to ensure data integrity
* Prepare reports for distribution and monitors for completion.
* Provide support to healthcare staff for EPIC and other EHR systems by troubleshooting and resolving application issues.
* Manage data integrity through error queue management and accurate reporting, including lab, prescription, and charge routing errors.
* Collaborate with clinical teams to enhance system efficiency and improve health information processes.
* Maintain user accounts, workstations, and system configurations to ensure smooth operations.
* Lead system testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance, ensuring compliance with privacy and security standard
* Oversight of the quality, timeliness, and accuracy of the medical record and patient indexes for patient care, legal, revenue, research, and regulatory needs
* Maintaining the security and integrity of health information
* Collection, quality control, and dissemination of data for comparative databases and statistical reports including specific disease and procedure registries
* Maintains and contributes to patient care by organizing and maintaining patients’ medical records and health information
* Answers requests for information and documents
* Updates and reviews medical records by reviewing information, notifying healthcare providers of record deficiencies, and tracking outstanding records
* Maintains patient confidence and protects our operations by keeping information confidential and complying with privacy policies and regulation
* Updates medical history in a timely manner
* Receiving and processing patient forms, medical histories, and test results
* Analyzing the information collected to ensure that it is correct and accurate
* Assessing health records and insurance claims
* Ensuring compliance with confidentiality laws and regulations
* Managing and updating data for clinical databases and registries
* Other duties as assigned.

**OCHIN Workforce Development Equal Opportunity Statement**

*OCHIN is an equal opportunity educational provider committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment for all. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination for all members of the OCHIN community, including learners, team members, and applicants. We do not discriminate based on race, creed, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.*

*OCHIN is committed to making decisions for program entry, training, and educational opportunities based on individual qualifications and abilities. We actively seek to attract learners and team members from diverse backgrounds and affirmatively support equal access and opportunity for women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, special disabled veterans, and other covered veterans, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

*We strive to create an inclusive learning environment that fosters the success of every individual and reflects the diverse communities we serve.*

**OCHIN Workforce Development Health Screenings and Immunization Requirements**

*To ensure the safety of our learners, partners, and communities, OCHIN requires all program participants—including those attending remote and in\-person training, internships, and externships—to be vaccinated with a COVID\-19 vaccine, as recommended by state and federal public health officials. Participants must provide proof of full vaccination or receive approval for a medical or religious exemption prior to program acceptance.*

*Additionally, for on\-site internships and externships, participants must provide proof of meeting the immunization requirements specific to the host site prior to acceptance into the program. These requirements may include, but are not limited to, vaccinations for influenza, hepatitis B, and MMR. Requests for exemptions based on medical or religious grounds will be reviewed and must comply with applicable laws and site\-specific policies.*

*Please note that many sites require participants to complete tuberculosis (Tb) testing and drug screening before beginning their placement. Participants are responsible for ensuring that all required health screenings are completed by the site’s deadline to avoid delays in program participation.*

*OCHIN is committed to working collaboratively with program participants and host sites to ensure compliance with these health and safety requirements while maintaining respect for individual beliefs and circumstances.*

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Knowtex.ai**

**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

 **LOCATION**


Remote (US)

**TRAVEL**


20–30%, federal and commercial sites

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**LICENSE**


RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours, with flexibility across time zones

  

**About** **Knowtex.ai**
========================


Knowtex is transforming healthcare documentation through ambient AI scribe technology that allows clinicians to focus on patients instead of computers. Our platform uses advanced AI to convert natural clinical conversations into accurate, comprehensive medical documentation — reducing clinician burnout while improving care quality.


We're scaling rapidly across both the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and a growing base of commercial health systems — two very different operating environments with one shared bar: the note has to be safe, complete, and trustworthy, every time, for every clinician who depends on it in real time.

**The Opportunity**
===================


We're at a critical inflection point. Over the next 90 days, this role will drive massive scaling across our federal and commercial portfolios.


We need a Clinical Implementation Specialist who is equal parts clinician, implementation scientist, and clinical informaticist — someone who can stand in front of a room of skeptical physicians one hour and sit inside an AI prompt the next, tracing a clinician's error report back to its root cause. You'll be the clinical voice our users trust, and the clinical judgment behind how our AI is tuned, turning what you hear on the front line into documentation that's safe, complete, and trusted by the providers who sign it.


Day to day, that means onboarding new sites and clinicians, running training, building the clinical champion network that makes adoption durable rather than a one\-time launch event, and leading recovery at sites that are struggling. You'll do this one clinician at a time and at scale, often in the same week: coaching a new user through their first generated note, and building the curriculum and playbook that carry that result everywhere else.


This role reports to the Director of Customer Delivery and works in daily partnership with the rest of Customer Delivery, and directly with Engineering (including the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers) to close the loop between what clinicians experience and what the product does.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Onboarding, Training Delivery \& Coaching 30%**
-------------------------------------------------

* Conduct live virtual training sessions for clinicians across all specialties and both federal and commercial sites (physicians, NPs, PAs, pharmacists, mental health providers)
* Present at approved provider and leadership staff meetings to provide platform updates, training, and support
* Lead virtual office hours and recurring Q\&A sessions providing just\-in\-time workflow support to users at every stage, from brand\-new to long\-tenured
* Onboard and coach new users individually through early activation, adapting your approach to specialty, technical comfort, and sector (federal vs. commercial)
* Deliver train\-the\-trainer sessions to build capacity among Site POCs and Clinical Champions
* Track training attendance, completion, satisfaction, and time\-to\-activation; feed findings back into training content and coaching approach

**Training \& Educational Materials 15%**
-----------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain training curriculum, job aids, and education resources for both federal and commercial audiences, including specialty\-specific modules
* Update materials continuously based on product changes, user feedback, and clinical best practice — this is a living library, not a one\-time build
* Design self\-paced and asynchronous resources so coaching capacity scales with user volume rather than growing linearly with it
* Develop release communication for feature updates and product changes — external materials for users, and internal briefings that prepare Customer Support and Implementation before rollout

**Clinical Champion Network 10%**
---------------------------------

* Identify Clinical Champions through both adoption data and relationships built in the field, then recruit and develop them to extend adoption support within their own facilities
* Build and facilitate an active Clinical Champion community of practice — peer learning, shared best practices, and a channel that surfaces problems early
* Sustain engagement over time, not just at launch; a champion network that goes quiet within a quarter isn't doing its job

**Implementation Strategy \& Service Recovery 20%**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute implementation strategy for new and scaling sites across both sectors
* Diagnose and lead service recovery for sites in one of two distinct situations — initial adoption struggles (never really got going) and negative first\-experience recovery (tried it, had a bad early experience, and are now skeptical or vocal) — and tailor your intervention to which one you're facing
* Conduct workflow assessments to identify integration opportunities and barriers, and translate findings into a concrete site\-level plan
* Identify patterns across sites — the failure modes that repeat, the interventions that consistently work — and document them in the implementation playbook so the next site starts ahead of where the last one did

**AI Prompt Judgment \& Clinical Quality 20%**
----------------------------------------------

* Build and maintain deep product understanding — how the AI generates notes, where prompts and templates drive behavior, and where the boundaries of the model's clinical judgment are
* Interpret clinician\-reported concerns and errors (missing findings, fabricated content, incorrect clinical reasoning) and perform root cause analysis to distinguish a prompt issue from a workflow issue from a genuine model limitation
* Recommend prompt changes and carry them through implementation, grounded in clinical judgment, safety, and quality standards — with the sole aim of keeping note output safe, complete, and aligned with provider expectations
* Escalate patient safety concerns immediately per protocol; no finding sits unreviewed
* Partner on the Clinical Quality Scoring Rubric and documentation audit findings where they intersect with training or prompt behavior

**Cross\-Functional Partnership with Engineering 5%**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Work directly with the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers to resolve live, customer\-facing issues in real time
* Serve as the trusted clinical voice inside product and engineering discussions — translating a clinician's frustration into a specific, actionable problem statement and making the clinical case for prioritization
* Contribute to longer\-term product and feature discussions informed by frontline patterns, not just individual tickets

**Who You Are**
===============

**CLINICAL BACKGROUND**

* Active clinical license (RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent) with 5\+ years of direct patient care experience
* Understanding of clinical documentation requirements, EHR workflows, and medical decision\-making across specialties
* Comfort operating in both federal (VA) and commercial healthcare environments — or a credible plan for ramping into whichever side is less familiar
* Understanding of HIPAA, medical\-legal documentation standards, and quality requirements

**IMPLEMENTATION SCIENCE, INFORMATICS \& AI**

* Experience with implementation science frameworks (RE\-AIM, CFIR) or equivalent structured approaches to adoption and change management
* Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, or equivalent) on a clinical, workflow, or quality problem
* Direct or adjacent experience with AI/NLP prompt design, prompt evaluation, or clinical documentation improvement technologies — you don't need to have built models, but you need to be comfortable reasoning about how a prompt change would or wouldn't fix a reported error
* Comfort working from product analytics and dashboards to identify patterns, not just anecdotes

**TRAINING \& EDUCATION**

* 3\+ years developing and delivering clinical education or healthcare IT training
* Demonstrated ability to build effective curriculum and measure its impact beyond satisfaction scores (retention, behavior change, time\-to\-activation)
* Experience with virtual training platforms and comfort presenting to groups from 5 to 100\+
* Track record adapting delivery across specialties and audiences with different technical proficiency

**COMMUNICATION \& JUDGMENT**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication; able to earn a skeptical clinician's trust quickly
* Strong collaborator across internal teams, with the credibility to advocate for clinical needs in technical discussions
* Comfortable delivering an executive briefing on short notice, then answering a support ticket an hour later — this role moves fluidly between strategic and hands\-on work
* Sound clinical and ethical judgment under time pressure, particularly around patient safety escalation

**MINDSET**

* Entrepreneurial, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to pick up work that doesn't have an obvious owner
* Genuinely mission\-driven — motivated by what's at stake when the technology in question touches real\-time clinical care, not just another SaaS rollout
* Sees Engineering, Product, and the rest of Customer Delivery as partners, not separate lanes — inclined to bring people in early instead of arriving with a finished answer

**Strongly preferred**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Health Administration, Public Health, Medical Education, Clinical Informatics, or related field
* Experience with ambient AI, clinical documentation improvement, or speech recognition technologies
* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-scaling environment where role boundaries were fluid
* VA clinical experience (staff clinician, clinical educator, or clinical informaticist) and commercial health system experience
* Section 508 accessibility compliance experience

**Key Collaborations**
======================

**Technical Product Manager \& On\-Call Engineers**


Direct, frequent partnership resolving live customer issues and shaping prompt and product changes; primary channel for surfacing root\-caused clinician concerns

**Director of Customer Delivery**


Weekly 1:1s and strategic planning; escalation point for systemic clinical quality, safety, or training effectiveness issues

**Implementation \& Customer Support**


Daily coordination on training schedules, go\-lives, service recovery execution, and clinical quality issues surfaced through tickets

**Site POCs \& Clinical Champions (federal and commercial)**


Primary clinical contact for training, workflow guidance, and frontline advocacy

**Why Knowtex?**
================

**Mission that matters**


What's at stake here is different from a typical tech rollout — this technology sits inside real\-time clinical care, and getting it wrong has consequences a dashboard bug never would. Every barrier you remove is a clinician who gets time back and a patient whose documentation is safer and more complete.

**A true 0\-to\-1 environment**


We're fast\-paced, hands\-on, and every hat gets worn by everyone. No job is too small — you'll answer tickets and deliver executive briefings in the same week, and both matter.

**Direct impact, direct influence**


You'll work hands\-on with frontline clinicians and directly with the engineers who build the product you rely on. Your root\-cause findings and prompt recommendations shape what ships next.

**Team \& culture**


A tight, cross\-functional team that treats the customer's voice — and the clinician's safety — as the center of gravity for every decision.

**Logistics**
=============

**LOCATION**


Remote, with travel required to federal and commercial sites for workflow assessments, go\-lives, service recovery visits, and training events (estimated 20–30%, adjusted to implementation needs)

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours with flexibility for training delivery across time zones and both federal and commercial calendars

**COMPENSATION**


Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus equity, comprehensive benefits, and professional development opportunities **.**

**To Apply**


We're looking for a clinician\-informaticist who loves teaching, thinks in root causes, and wants to shape how AI shows up safely in real clinical practice — across both federal and commercial healthcare. Please submit your resume and a cover letter addressing:

* Why a role spanning clinical practice, implementation science, and AI prompting excites you
* An example of diagnosing a clinical or workflow problem down to its root cause, and what you changed as a result
* Your approach to service recovery at a site that's either never adopted well or had a bad first experience


Knowtex.ai is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clinicians and patients we serve.


Compensation Range: $110K \- $180K

**Job Title:** EHR (Electronic Health Records) Application Analyst \- Lead

**Department:** PFS Applications

**Location:** Hybrid (Onsite \& Remote); 100 Kings Highway South, Rochester, NY 14617

**Hours Per Week:** 40

**Schedule:** Typically, 8am \-4:30pm

 **SUMMARY:**  

The EHR Application Analyst Lead is the most senior individual contribution on the analyst team, serving as the primary subject matter expert for complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) system issues, configurations, and optimization. This role tackles the highest\-complexity work, holds multiple Epic certifications and serves as the top technical escalation resource for the team. The Application Analyst Lead also takes on coordination responsibilities – helping organize team workflows and supporting project management – while driving continuous improvement and sharing deep expertise across the organization.
  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Lead System Support and Maintenance:
  

* Serve as the primary technical escalation resource for the most complex system issues, errors, and configuration, applying expert\-level, troubleshooting to drive resolution with minimal disruption to patient care.
* Work closely with operations to develop and coordinate issue resolution plans for high\-impact or cross\-team problems.
* Oversee and coordinate routine maintenance activities \- including software updates, patches, and upgrade \- ensuring stability and security standards are met.
* Coordinate and lead testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, following established change management processes.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, serving as the lead resource for complex or escalated after\-hours issues.

  

System Optimization and Continuous Improvement:
  

* Lead system optimization efforts, applying expert knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare workflows to identify inefficiencies and drive measurable improvement.
* Conduct advanced workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build opportunities and optimization needs.
* Advance optimization and enhancement requests through governance and change management channels; provide expert input on prioritization decisions.
* Apply cross\-application integration knowledge to ensure cohesive system performance and identify dependencies across modules.
* Contribute technical expertise to strategic planning discussions, informing roadmap direction and technology decisions.

  

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:
  

* Coordinate work among team members on EHR projects, upgrades, and initiatives — tracking tasks, maintaining issue logs, facilitating meetings, and communicating status to project or team leads.
* Take on light project management responsibilities for defined initiatives, including maintaining project plans and coordinating timelines across stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for EHR vendor relationships, managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and participating in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams — including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors — to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication.

  

Documentation and Knowledge Management:  

* Maintain and own comprehensive documentation of complex system configurations, processes, and build decisions.

Training and Mentorship:  

* Serve as a go\-to knowledge resource for junior and senior analysts, providing guidance on complex issues and sharing best practices.

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.

* Minimum of five (5\) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Epic Application Analyst, Clinical Systems Analyst, or in a similar healthcare IT role supporting EHR implementation, optimization, and system support.

Job ID: 2617080

**Location:** Aberdeen Proving Ground, MD, US

**Travel:** Yes \- 10% of the time

 **Description**


SAIC is seeking a **SIGINT Training Specialist** in **Aberdeen Proving Grounds, MD.**


**JOB DESCRIPTION:**



The SIGINT Training Specialist will develop, deliver, and maintain training programs supporting U.S. Army Signals Intelligence (SIGINT) missions. This role supports C5ISR Quick Reaction Capability (QRC) efforts by developing and delivering accurate, timely, and mission\-focused instruction on SIGINT systems, tools, doctrine, and workflows. The ideal candidate has operational SATCOM and RF experience, strong instructional skills, and the ability to work closely with engineers, system administrators, and program leadership.


**JOB DUTIES:**


* Develop, update, and deliver training materials for Army SIGINT systems, including classroom instruction, hands\-on equipment training, and field\-based exercises.
* Provide training for SIGINT collection platforms.
* Conduct new equipment training (NET), operator refresher training, and mission\-specific instructional requirements as needed.
* Coordinate with system and network engineers, system developers, and technical project leads to ensure training content reflects the latest capabilities, tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), and system upgrades.
* Create and maintain technical documents, user guides, quick\-reference cards, and multimedia instructional content.
* Perform on\-site support during testing events, fielding activities, and operational deployments when required.
* Engage in cross\-functional collaboration supporting SIGINT equipment integration efforts as needed.


**Qualifications**


**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CLEARANCE:**

* Bachelors and five (5\) years’ experience. Additional years’ experience accepted in lieu of a degree.
* Experience in Military related training preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Possess a working knowledge of IT infrastructure, encompassing both system administration and network operations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) products.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies for rapid integration into current and evolving requirements.
* Ability to lift 50 pounds and stand for long periods of time.
* Ability to travel periodically (CONUS), up to 20%.
* Candidate must be a US Citizen.
* Active TS security clearance, ability to obtain a TS/SCI.

**DESIRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 5 Years Signals Intelligence (SIGINT) or SATCOM RF operations, collection, or system support.
* Prior military instructor certification (e.g., ABIC) or equivalent civilian training certification.
* Experience with training development frameworks such as ADDIE.
* Familiarity with electronic warfare (EW), spectrum operations, or SATCOM.
* Experience with system administration and integration.


Target salary range: $80,001 \- $120,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Acumen Technology is looking for a curious, detail\-obsessed Onboarding Specialist to be the first person our new clients work with, and the reason their support experience is good from day one.


Based out of the Music City, Nashville, TN, Acumen Technology is a leading IT Managed Services Provider focusing on financial institutions, healthcare, and other industries that are serious about security and doing IT right. Being a member of our team means weekly in\-office lunches, company events, a comprehensive benefits package, and a team that genuinely backs each other up.


This is a role for someone who actually likes documentation. When a new client signs, you are the one who walks their environment, finds the undocumented server in the closet, figures out who owns the domain registrar, and writes it all down so clearly that a tech who has never touched the account can resolve a ticket at 4:45 on a Friday. Between onboardings, you'll bring that same discovery and documentation work to our Professional Services project load. If that sounds satisfying rather than tedious, keep reading.

**A successful Onboarding Specialist would:**

* Own discovery for every new client: networks, servers, firewalls, line\-of\-business applications, vendors, licensing, credentials, backups, and the dozen things nobody thought to mention.
* Produce documentation that is accurate, structured, and genuinely useful to the engineers who inherit it, not a dump of raw data.
* Ask the questions nobody else thought to ask. The gaps you find in week one are the outages we don't have in month six.
* Work independently and drive the discovery process forward without being chased for status.
* Partner closely with our technical team during tooling deployment. You won't be deploying agents or standing up the stack, but you'll make sure the people who do have everything they need and that the results get documented.
* Support Professional Services project work between onboardings, related to Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Azure efforts.
* Be the face of Acumen Technology to their clients, performing their job with excellent customer service and communication.
* Support our core values and commit to always improving.

**Beyond Onboarding:**


Onboarding is the core of this role, but it isn't the whole job. Our Professional Services team runs client projects outside the scope of the managed services agreement, and you'll support that work between onboardings. That includes but not limited to, Entra ID migrations and tenant consolidations, Microsoft 365 tenant\-to\-tenant moves, SharePoint and Teams rollouts, email security and Exchange Online work. If you want exposure to a steady stream of M365 and other project work without being on the hook for the whole project, this is a good seat.

**Onsite Expectations:**


Onboarding is hands\-on work, and this role does necessitate time on site. Expect to visit client locations throughout Middle Tennessee: walking server rooms and wiring closets, meeting clients face to face and verifying in person what you were told over email. The pace follows our onboarding schedule, so some weeks are heavily onsite and others are not. If you want a role that is fully remote by default, this isn't it.

**Work From Home/In Office:**


Acumen Technology is a hybrid workplace, and we support a work from home environment between client visits. We provide a budget for all the technology you'll need for a comfortable work from home office. We also have in\-office days because we value the collaboration that allows.

**Acumen's Commitment to our Employees:**


We will do everything we can to aid your growth in the IT field. Wherever life takes you, we want Acumen to have helped you get there.

**Acumen Technology Core Values:**

* Intentional Everything
* I've Got Your Back
* Do IT Right
* Adapt \& Overcome
* Deliver with Confidence \& Passion

  

**Requirements**  

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal and both in\-person and remote.
* 2\-4 years of hands\-on systems administration or equivalent experience. You need to recognize what you're looking at in a server rack or a firewall config to document it correctly.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, networking fundamentals, and backup/DR concepts.
* Familiarity with Entra ID (Azure AD) and the Microsoft 365 admin center. Experience supporting a tenant migration or Entra\-related project is a strong plus.
* Exceptional attention to detail. Small omissions in onboarding become large problems in support.
* Demonstrated documentation skills, and an appetite for the work.
* A self\-starter who is comfortable managing their own workload with minimal oversight.
* Strong interviewing and active listening skills: the ability to pull information out of client stakeholders who may not know what you need.
* Comfort working with existing MSP documentation platforms and a willingness to improve the structure, not just fill in fields.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for regular client site visits.
* Preferred Certifications, such as: Microsoft Certified Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\), Microsoft Certified Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ\-802\), Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\), Microsoft 365 Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\), CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or ITIL 4 Foundation, Cisco CCNA, Fortinet NSA 2 or above.

  

**Benefits**  

* $64,000 \- 84,000 annually depending on fit and experience
* Hybrid workplace with onsite client work
* 100% employer paid health insurance (medical and dental)
* Mileage and phone reimbursement
* Collaborative team culture
* 401k with a maximum 4% match
